route_title: 17-layer Al2O3/MgF2 defect cavity with tight refinement bounds around Round 2 optimum
compilation_rationale: Compiles a fixed 17-layer dielectric stack with explicit Al2O3/MgF2 alternation on fused silica. Uses coherent smatrix solver over 255–1100 nm. Initial thicknesses from the provided list are expanded with ±15% bounds per layer. Three separate mean transmittance objectives cover the high-transmit passband and two suppression bands as requested, with all conditions scored independently.
